Fabric – Dedicated Server Crash Fix:
The crash affecting Fabric 1.21.1 dedicated servers was caused by client-side methods being incorrectly accessed during initialization. This has been corrected, and the mod should now load properly on dedicated servers.

Dedicated Server – Spawn Rate Adjustment:
Separately, I've slightly increased the Blockling spawn rates on dedicated servers for both Fabric and NeoForge to make Blocklings a little more common in multiplayer environments.

Thank you for helping improve BlocklingsRevival Edition!

releases.notes:
## Blocklings Revival 1.0.9

First of all, I apologize for the issues in version 1.0.8. I had a hard drive malfunction while working on the update, and unfortunately an issue slipped through testing.

### 🌳 Woodcutting Fix
- Fixed an issue where Blocklings would only cut down trees grown from Oak Saplings.
- Blocklings should now correctly recognize and cut other supported tree types.

### 📦 Improved Item Pickup
Because Blocklings are very small, Minecraft's vanilla item pickup system would often fail to detect dropped items even when a Blockling walked directly over them.

This has now been improved for both Fabric and NeoForge:

- Blocklings can pick up dropped items within approximately 2.5 blocks while walking.
- After cutting down a tree, including when using the Falling Tree behavior, the Blockling will collect dropped items around the trunk.
- Collected items are placed directly into the Blockling's inventory instead of being left on the ground.

Thank you for your patience, and sorry again for the problems with 1.0.8.

releases.notes:
## Blocklings Revival 1.0.8(NeoForge + Fabric)
### Persistence
Tamed blocklings no longer vanish when you leave their chunk. Their backpack stays with them. Tools and gathered items drop correctly on death.
### Gathering — `dropGatheredItemsWhenFull`
New config option (NeoForge and Fabric).
- **`false` (default):** mining, woodcutting and farming **pause** when the backpack is full. Nothing is thrown on the ground, so nothing despawns after 5 minutes. Pair this with a deposit-to-container task to keep them working.
- **`true`:** they keep working with a full bag and **drop the surplus on the ground**. Those item entities despawn after ~5 minutes if nobody picks them up (vanilla). Use this if you want the old “keep chopping and leave a pile” behaviour.
### Falling Tree
When [Falling Tree](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/falling-tree) is installed, a woodcutting blockling fells the whole tree the same way a player would, then scoops the nearby drops into its inventory.
### Mending & XP
XP the blockling earns (mining, woodcutting, farming, combat) is applied like vanilla: **Mending repairs its tools first**, leftover XP goes into the matching skill bar. Right-click (or throw nearby) a Bottle o’ Enchanting to feed combat XP.
### Combat
- **Attack Owner's Attacker** (Novice Guard): your blockling fights whoever hits you.
- **Tactical Retreat** ([#5](https://github.com/MLGMagicHoodini/Blocklings-Revival/issues/5)): buy **Advanced Guard** (Combat 15). Set a retreat health % — below that, it stops fighting and runs back to you. Protection mode can also cover your other tamed mobs / blocklings.
### “Please stop eating my house”
Woodcutting blocklings **ignore logs you placed**. Cabins, floors and decorative wood are no longer treated as trees. Natural trees are still fair game.
### GUI
Equipment / tasks / skills stay aligned when you resize the game window, like vanilla inventories. Slots no longer drift, and the HUD no longer shows through the panel.
### Also
Woodcut + Follow: after a tree is done, the blockling **walks** back to you instead of teleporting like a forest terminator. Mixed wood types and elevated trunks are handled more reliably.

releases.notes:
## Bug fix — Tasks screen crash
### What was broken
Opening a task configuration (for example a fighting/hunting task) could crash the game with:
`java.lang.StackOverflowError: mouseReleased event handler`
This often happened on the **Tasks** screen when a task name was longer than 32 characters — common with some translated names (Italian, Dutch, Portuguese, etc.).
### Cause
The task name text field could enter an infinite loop:
`setText` → `EditBox.setValue` → responder → `setText` again.
Minecraft's `EditBox` stores truncated text but notifies listeners with the full string, which retriggered the update forever.
### What we fixed
- Added a guard in `TextFieldControl` to stop recursive text updates.
- Increased the task name field limit to **64 characters** so long localized names are kept correctly.
- Fixed name field setup order on the Stats screen.
- Shared fix in the `common` module, so **NeoForge and Fabric** are both covered.
### How to verify
1. Open a Blockling's **Tasks** screen.
2. Configure a combat task (Hunt, Retaliate, Attack Owner's Target, etc.).
3. Use a language with long task names, or rename a task with a long custom name.
4. The screen should open normally with no crash.

releases.notes:
### Fixes
- **C2ME / chunk generation crash**
  - Spawning a blockling while chunks were generating (especially with C2ME) could crash the server with a `ConcurrentModificationException` on a C2ME worker thread.
  - Cause: attack-target setup created real entities (e.g. bees). Vanilla bee AI uses the server thread’s `ThreadLocalRandom`, which breaks off-thread.
  - Fix: targets are now classified from `EntityType` / `MobCategory` only. No entities are created during spawn or on C2ME threads. GUI previews are still created on the client only.
- **Held item rendering**
  - Tools and items in a blockling’s hands were misplaced or rotated wrong.
  - Items now follow the arm pose again (original 180° / 190° hand offsets) so pickaxes, swords, and other equipment sit correctly in the stub arms, including left and right hands.
### Additions
- **New type: Pumpkin**
  - Food: pumpkin, carved pumpkin, jack o’lantern, pumpkin pie, pumpkin seeds
  - Spawn: Overworld, under open sky, on grass or farmland, near a pumpkin or pumpkin stem
  - Farming specialist (higher farming speed)
  - Passive: grows nearby crops and pumpkin stems
  - Active (Shift + right-click, empty hand): **Harvest Burst** — accelerates every crop in range
### Compatibility
- **Mystical Agriculture** (optional — only if the mod is installed)
  - Extra Farmer skills appear in the farming tree (Essence Farmer, Mystical Almanac, resow, watering, essence farmland, and related bonuses).
  - Blocklings can farm Mystical Agriculture crops and seeds (crop/seed whitelist after Almanac).
  - They can use watering cans, convert vanilla farmland to essence farmland, and place growth accelerators from their inventory.
  - Inferium / Prosperity / Soulium ores can be mined like other ores.
  - No hard dependency: without Mystical Agriculture, the vanilla skill tree is unchanged.

releases.notes:
## Bug fixes
- Tool animations were stretched over the entire block break, so mining hard blocks looked frozen. Swings now run at a fixed 8-tick cadence.
- The glowstone blockling removed and replaced its light block every tick, causing constant flicker. The light only moves when the blockling travels more than 2 blocks.
- Partially chopped logs broke tree detection, leaving trees half-standing. Logs and leaves are now tag-based and a trunk may mix normal and chopped logs.
- Chopped logs dropped nothing, because the block entity was missing from the loot context.
- Blocklings chopped down wooden builds. Stripped logs and full wood blocks are now excluded.
- The take task emptied every container slot and counted whatever came out as the requested item, deleting unrelated items and creating the wanted one out of thin air.
- On Fabric, inserting "into slot N" actually inserted into the whole inventory, corrupting free-space calculations.
- The take task could not use composters or ender chests, unlike the deposit task.
- On Fabric the whistle never renamed itself after binding, even though teleport and sound worked.
- Reading a blockling's custom name without a null check could crash the player inventory tick.
- Actions synced every tick and clients sent packets the server always rejected. Only start/stop crosses the wire now.
- Blockling state was broadcast to every player in the level; it is now limited to players within 160 blocks.
- The block-break overlay was resent even when nothing changed.
- Large-tree searches were quadratic; visited positions now use a hash set.
- Every blockling was named "Blockling", making types indistinguishable. Names now carry the type, e.g. "Obsidian Blockling".
## Mod compatibility
Nothing below is a required dependency. Containers go through the loader APIs (`IItemHandler` capability on NeoForge, Transfer API on Fabric), so any mod exposing an inventory works without being known to the code.
Supported through code changes:
- HT's TreeChop
- Falling Tree
- Applied Energistics 2 (+ AE2 Wireless Terminals, Applied Mekanistics)
- Mekanism
- Sophisticated Backpacks / Sophisticated Core
- Create (+ Create: Enchantment Industry, Create Aeronautics)
- JourneyMap, Xaero's Minimap, Xaero's World Map, VoxelMap
- Jade
- Scalable Lux and other lighting/performance mods
Verified as conflict-free, no integration needed:
- JEI, GuideME, AppleSkin, Jade
- Clumps, ModernFix, EntityCulling, Puzzles Lib, Balm, Architectury API
- Mouse Tweaks, Inventory Essentials
- Waystones, Trading Post, Gravestone, Sable, Diagonal Fences, Leaves Be Gone
- FTB Essentials, FTB Library
- Essential Mod
## Needs testing
Nothing was tested in game; both jars were only compiled. In rough priority order:
- Take task pointed at a Mekanism machine or an AE2 ME interface (biggest behaviour change)
- Deposit and take on Sophisticated Backpacks / barrels
- Chopping a tree with HT's TreeChop installed
- Chopping a tree with Falling Tree installed
- Blockling type names showing on JourneyMap and Xaero's
- Light flicker with Scalable Lux installed

readmeSummary: Blocklings Revival is a community-led continuation of Blocklings by Willr27, maintained and updated to keep the mod playable and relevant on modern modloaders.
